autoReplyPolling.note: When enabled with CronCreate, auto-checks replies every N minutes. lastCheckedAt tracks the most recent check time so each cycle only fetches new messages.

note_language: "en" for English (default), "zh" for Chinese. Controls email language and Skill UI prompts.
note_autoApprove: Set to true to skip draft review and send emails immediately. When combined with autoReplyPolling, the full pipeline runs hands-free.
note_teamMembers: Configure your team members here. They appear as handoff targets when transferring a prospect to a human.

workingHours.note: Working hours in prospect's local time (24h format). Outreach emails are only sent during this window. Reply emails ignore this restriction.

note_timezone: Default timezone when TLD lookup fails. TLD mapping: .cn→Asia/Shanghai, .jp→Asia/Tokyo, .kr→Asia/Seoul, .de→Europe/Berlin, .fr→Europe/Paris, .uk→Europe/London, .au→Australia/Sydney, .in→Asia/Kolkata, .br→America/Sao_Paulo, .us→America/New_York, .ca→America/Toronto
